mandatoryCriteria: People directory scoping: GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/people and /members return active eligible members for the specified project
Workspace owner inclusion: Workspace owner is synthesized and included in project people directory even when not explicitly listed in the project_memberships table
Strict sibling exclusion: Members from sibling projects or unrelated workspaces are never returned; zero cross-project leakage
Removed members excluded: Users with status 'removed' are excluded from people pickers and active directory
Privacy and role checks: Outsiders probing people directory receive 404 NOT_FOUND
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/people and /members endpoints, workspace owner synthesis, sibling exclusion, and removed member filtering on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Frontend autocomplete picker widget is handled by UI.
